comment: ODIN's Timepix3 camera for the twin (efu/README.md). The configuration used at ESS is not public: 256 x 256 chip pixels scaled up 16 times give the 4096 x 4096 pixels of the real ODIN file; 14 Hz pulses. The twin sends each neutron as a cluster of 4 adjacent hits at the same time, so two neutrons make one cluster only if they come within 1 ns and their pixels touch (the EFU joins two hits when distance^2 < MaxCoordinateGap^2, strictly: 2 joins touching pixels, diagonals included)
